acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given the initialized project When I implement the database layer Then a Dexie database instance is created with name 'flowline-finance-studio'
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the accounts table exists with fields: id, name, type, balance, interestRate, minimumPayment, lender, interestType, createdAt, updatedAt
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the flexiFacility table exists with fields: id, name, type, creditLimit, currentBalance, interestRate, createdAt, updatedAt
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the income table exists with fields: id, source, amount, paymentDate, createdAt
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the expenses table exists with fields: id, category, amount, date, createdAt
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the balanceSnapshots table exists with fields: id, accountId, date, balance, notes, createdAt
Given the database is initialized When I check the schema Then the settings table exists with fields: key, value
Given the types are created When I check src/types/ Then TypeScript interfaces exist for: DebtAccount, FlexiFacility, IncomeEntry, ExpenseEntry, BalanceSnapshot
Given the types are created When I check account types Then AccountType enum includes: 'home_loan' | 'vehicle_finance' | 'personal_loan' | 'credit_card'
Given the types are created When I check facility types Then FlexiFacilityType enum includes: 'fnb_flexi' | 'standard_bank_access'
Given all types are defined When I check monetary value storage Then all monetary values (balance, amounts, rates) are stored as strings for big.js precision
Given all types are defined When I check date storage Then all dates are stored as ISO strings
Given the database module is complete When I import from src/lib/db/index.ts Then the database instance is exported and usable
Given the types module is complete When I import from src/types/index.ts Then all types are re-exported via barrel exports

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: FlowlineDB class definition with accounts, flexiFacility, income, expenses, balanceSnapshots, settings tables. Uses Dexie.js for IndexedDB wrapper.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Monetary values stored as string for big.js precision. Dates as ISO strings. Rates as decimal strings (0.115 = 11.5%). IDs auto-incremented (++id).

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use Dexie.js wrapper over IndexedDB for structured queries, async operations, React hooks integration (useLiveQuery), and future Dexie Cloud migration path.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: Use big.js for all monetary calculations to avoid floating-point precision errors. Store as strings to preserve precision.

node.package: Arbitrary precision arithmetic for financial calculations

constraints.constraint: All monetary values MUST be stored as strings (e.g., "500000.00") to preserve big.js precision
Use Dexie.js Table type with generics: Dexie.Table<Type, number> for auto-increment id, Dexie.Table<Type, string> for string keys
Dates MUST be stored as ISO strings (e.g., "2025-11-28T00:00:00.000Z")
Interest rates stored as decimal strings (0.115 = 11.5%)
Use path alias @/ for all imports (configured in tsconfig.json and vite.config.ts)
Database version starts at 1, increment for schema migrations
Folder structure: types in src/types/, db in src/lib/db/
All dependencies already installed - no npm install needed

tests.standards: Use Vitest with React Testing Library. Test files use *.test.ts extension. Test setup at tests/setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom matchers. Tests run with `npm run test` or `npm run test:run`. Use jsdom environment for browser APIs like IndexedDB.
